subtitle: A second Claesz study — same painter, cleaner light, more contemporary eye.

tiles: Continuing my reading on Pieter Claesz
A contemporary take on the tabletop still life
The pieces I kept for their freshness
challenge: After spending time on a more historically faithful Claesz set, I wanted to see what happened if I held onto the painter's instincts — restraint, balance, a single soft light — but let the palette and staging feel current. Could it still be honest to Claesz, or would it stop being his?
approach: I kept reading about his approach, then drafted another round of variations with cleaner light, simpler color, and slightly more contemporary staging. I kept the ones that still felt rooted in his sensibility but that I'd be genuinely happy to live with today.
result: A companion set to the first Claesz collection — same spirit, cleaner feel. They're available as prints if anyone else enjoys that same quiet with a little more air in it.
role_headline: Contemporary Still Life After Pieter Claesz
